focus: Ecuadorian tax-benefit surface: personal income tax (LRTI Art. 36), VAT (Art. 65 chain: 12% -> 13% -> 15% applied from April 2024), ICE excises, IESS social insurance contributions, and the Bono de Desarrollo Humano.
purpose: Household-level comparison-oracle and supporting-source references for Ecuador Axiom coverage. None of these are legal authority.
oracle_scope: A RuleSpec oracle must be an executable, pinned external calculator that accepts household-level inputs and returns household-level tax-benefit outputs comparable to Axiom outputs. Aggregate simulators, distributional reports, parameter documentation, and public model summaries are supporting references only, not oracles.

oracles.name: ECUAMOD
oracles.dataset: ENIGHUR 2011/12 + ENEMDU 2019-2022 based input microdata (shipped with the licensed bundle where included)
oracles.role: Household-level tax-benefit comparison oracle for Ecuador. Policy years 2011-25. Report CR-ECUAMOD-v5.1 (UNU-WIDER).

availability_check.detail: The locally held licensed SOUTHMOD bundle (see rulespec-tz oracle-index: SOUTHMOD_A4.0; EUROMOD runtime proven on the Ghana and Rwanda lanes) must be inventoried for ECUAMOD EC systems before wiring. Validation frame: ECUAMOD v5.1, policy years 2011-25.
